newsitem.title: ITALY: FORECAST-Italian employers see lower 97 GDP growth.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Italian employers see lower 97 GDP growth.

text.p: Italian economic growth will be closer to one percent than 1.5 percent in 1997 and will certainly miss the government's two percent target, the leader of employers' federation Confindustria said on Friday.
"Our latest forecasts point to growth more around one percent than 1.5 percent in 1997," Giorgio Fossa told a group of foreign reporters. "Growth will be very, very low," he added.
Fossa upheld Confindustria's earlier predictions that Italy's gross domestic product (GDP) this year should rise some 0.7 percent.
He urged the government to introduce fiscal breaks to encourage output and said that under the current tax regime the country risked losing investment from abroad.
"We've got problems not just attracting multi-nationals to Italy but also holding onto the ones we've got," he said. -- Crispian Balmer, 396 6782501
